g.text: Overall test performance: original primary vs attention study
Each seed pools all five held-out splits (5,618 samples); bars show mean +/- sample SD across three seeds.
Cross-study comparison: the follow-up also fixes Transformer width at 96 and changes the GAT output-head policy.
This is not an isolated causal estimate of changing heads/dropout. Original signal750 and ablations are separate experiments.
